title: CareerLoop English & Comprehension — Set 01
patternNote: CareerLoop placement pattern: an English-heavy paper with short reasoning, quant and General Awareness modules. 30 original questions written for CareerLoop / 30 minutes / +1 per correct / −0.25 per wrong.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'candid'.
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means honest and direct, so 'frank' is the closest synonym.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to 'scarce'.
questions.explanation: 'Scarce' means in short supply; its opposite is 'abundant'.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'meticulous'.
questions.explanation: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail, so 'careful' is the synonym.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to 'obscure'.
questions.explanation: 'Obscure' means unclear or hard to understand; its antonym is 'clear'.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: What does the idiom 'to burn the midnight oil' mean?
options: To work late into the night
questions.explanation: The idiom refers to studying or working late into the night, from the days of oil lamps.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: One word for 'a speech made without preparation' is:
questions.explanation: An 'extempore' speech is delivered without prior preparation.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Fill in the blank: Neither of the boys ______ present.
questions.explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb, so 'was' is correct.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Fill in the blank: He is senior ______ me.
questions.explanation: Adjectives such as senior, junior, superior and inferior take 'to', not 'than'.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Identify the grammatically incorrect part: (A) She is one of the best (B) singer (C) in the class (D) No error
questions.explanation: After 'one of the best' a plural noun is required: 'one of the best singers in the class'.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the correct passive form of: 'The teacher praised him.'
options: He was praised by the teacher.
questions.explanation: The past-tense active sentence becomes 'He was praised by the teacher' in the passive voice.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'occurrence' — double c, double r, and 'ence' at the end.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am busy.'
options: He said that he is busy.
He said that he was busy.
He says that he was busy.
He said that I am busy.
questions.explanation: In indirect speech the present tense of the quoted sentence shifts to the past: 'He said that he was busy.'

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to 'generous'.
questions.explanation: 'Generous' means willing to give freely; its opposite is 'miserly'. 'Kind' and 'liberal' are synonyms.

questions.subject: English
questions.stem: Fill in the blank: Hardly had I reached the station ______ the train left.
questions.explanation: The fixed pair is 'hardly had ... when'. 'No sooner' is the construction that takes 'than'.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: Find the next number: 11, 13, 17, 19, ?
questions.explanation: The series lists consecutive prime numbers, so the next prime after 19 is 23.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: Find the odd one out: 16, 25, 36, 49, 60
questions.explanation: 16, 25, 36 and 49 are perfect squares (4², 5², 6², 7²). 60 is not a perfect square.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: If PEN is coded as QFO, how is BOOK coded in the same code?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one place forward: B→C, O→P, O→P, K→L, giving CPPL.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: A person facing south turns left. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Facing south, a left turn (anti-clockwise) points east.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?
questions.explanation: A bird lives in a nest and a bee lives in a hive.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.stem: 'The son of my father's sister' is related to me as my:
questions.explanation: My father's sister is my aunt, and her son is my cousin.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.stem: What is 12.5% of 800?
questions.explanation: 12.5% is one-eighth, and 800 ÷ 8 = 100.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.stem: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 and their sum is 45. What is the smaller number?
questions.explanation: The ratio parts total 5, so one part is 45 ÷ 5 = 9. The smaller number is 2 × 9 = 18.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.stem: The average of six numbers is 20. When a seventh number is added, the average becomes 22. What is the seventh number?
questions.explanation: The original total is 6 × 20 = 120. The new total is 7 × 22 = 154, so the added number is 34.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.stem: A 90 m long train running at 36 km/h passes a pole. How long does it take?
questions.explanation: 36 km/h = 10 m/s. Time = 90 ÷ 10 = 9 seconds.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.stem: An article costing ₹250 is sold for ₹300. What is the profit percentage?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is the capital of Canada, although Toronto is its largest city.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which is the smallest prime number?
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest prime number and the only even prime. 1 is not prime and 0 is not prime.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: How many bones are there in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human skeleton has 206 bones. Babies are born with more, some of which fuse during growth.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who is credited with inventing the telephone?
questions.explanation: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone and received the first patent for it in 1876.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the atmosphere, while oxygen is about 21%.
